subject.title: feat(clients): provider-grouped model picker with fast, verbosity, and inherited-thinking controls

question: Should native chat reuse the existing web provider Fast-mode support mapping now, or should Fast remain out of this PR until the gateway exposes a shared provider capability?
rationale: The patch currently chooses an unconditional UI control while the supported web client uses a provider-specific rule; choosing the durable cross-client capability boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Reuse the web capability rule
options.body: Gate the native Fast control with the existing supported-provider behavior and add focused coverage for both a supported and unsupported provider.

options.title: Add a shared gateway capability
options.body: Extend the model/session contract with explicit Fast support metadata before exposing the control across native clients.

options.title: Defer Fast mode
options.body: Land only the independently valid picker, verbosity, and inherited-thinking work, leaving Fast for a capability-backed follow-up.

recommendation.title: Reuse the web capability rule
recommendation.body: Gate the native Fast control with the existing supported-provider behavior and add focused coverage for both a supported and unsupported provider.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged native-chat parity history and current implementation place this capability-boundary decision closest to this area.
